charge_port.notes: Nissan Canada 2014 sheet: quick charge port "-" on the S (standard on SV and SL). In the US the port is an option on the S (US kits), so a US S with the Quick Charge Package has CHAdeMO; the Canadian reading is used. 2015 assumed the same as 2014.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: CHAdeMO port. Nissan's Dec 2024 Supercharger programme covers only the CCS Ariya; Electrek says the Leaf is excluded and uses CHAdeMO. No Nissan adapter exists for the Leaf.
